Apple's new iPhone Handoff feature allows users to share a single phone number between two iPhones, and T-Mobile will charge $5 per month for it. Here are the details.

Deutsche Telekom also requires a subscription to a related service

During its earlier WWDC keynote this year, Apple briefly showed a slide listing dozens of features and improvements coming in iOS 27, including the ability to "switch a single phone number between two iPhones."

At yesterday's "Surprise and Shine" event, Apple's iPhone product marketing vice president Kaiann Drance shared more details about the feature:

What wasn't mentioned at the event—at least for T-Mobile customers—is that the feature will cost an extra $5 per month, as Stetson Doggett pointed out on X:

Apple's iPhone Handoff support page notes that "carrier fees may apply to use iPhone Handoff" and advises customers to check with their carrier for details.

9to5Mac reviewed Deutsche Telekom's announcement of the feature and found that the carrier does not charge extra for iPhone Handoff itself.

However, the feature is part of the carrier's MultiSIM service. Adding MultiSIM to an existing monthly plan costs an additional €6.95 per month, although some designated plans already include one free MultiSIM.
